digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI; Mgombato
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama, Swahili: share the name chivundza kesi (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: When it flowers, the bees come buzzing; and when you have a dispute, people say it can end the case in your favour.
teaser.sw: Ukichanua, nyuki huja wakivuma; na ukiwa na ugomvi, watu husema unaweza kumaliza kesi kwa faida yako.

summary.en: *Chivuma nyuchi* is a small herb whose flowers draw buzzing bees. Under its other name, *chivundza kesi*, it is used to end a dispute in the user's favour.
summary.sw: *Chivuma nyuchi* ni mmea mdogo ambao maua yake huvutia nyuki wanaovuma. Kwa jina lake jingine, *chivundza kesi*, hutumika kumaliza ugomvi kwa faida ya anayeutumia.

about.en: *Agathisanthemum bojeri* is a small herb or sub-shrub of the coffee family. It has narrow, opposite leaves and dense, rounded heads of tiny white to pink or mauve tubular flowers at the tips of the stems. Pakia classes it as a herb and notes that Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Agathisanthemum bojeri* ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kidogo cha familia ya mibuni (mkahawa). Una majani membamba yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na vichwa vizito vya mviringo vya maua madogo sana ya umbo la mrija, meupe hadi waridi au zambarau hafifu, kwenye ncha za mashina. Pakia anauweka katika kundi la mimea midogo (herbs) na anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It grows in grassland, bushland and open sandy places in East Africa, including the coast.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika za majani, vichakani na sehemu wazi za mchanga Afrika Mashariki, ikiwemo pwani.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is used to end (*vundza*) a dispute in favour of the user, hence the name *chivundza kesi*, 'case terminator'. Other Digo plants are also named for settling or stirring disputes, such as *mvundza jembe* and *mtsimbi kaya*. Mgombato adds that *chivuma nyuchi* is also the name of a dance.
culture.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba mmea huu hutumika kumaliza (*vundza*) ugomvi kwa faida ya anayeutumia, ndiyo sababu unaitwa *chivundza kesi*, 'kimaliza kesi'. Mimea mingine ya Kidigo pia imepewa majina kwa kusuluhisha au kuchochea ugomvi, kama *mvundza jembe* na *mtsimbi kaya*. Mgombato inaongeza kwamba *chivuma nyuchi* pia ni jina la ngoma.

names.en: *Chivuma nyuchi* means 'buzzing bees': when it flowers, bees visit it often. *Chivundza kesi* means 'case terminator', from *vundza*, to end, and *kesi*, a legal case. Duruma, Giriama and Swahili share that name. Mgombato gives two Swahili names, *kivunjahakumu* ('judgement breaker') and *mcheka na mbingu*.
names.sw: *Chivuma nyuchi* maana yake 'nyuki wanaovuma': unapochanua, nyuki huutembelea mara kwa mara. *Chivundza kesi* maana yake 'kimaliza kesi', kutoka *vundza*, kumaliza, na *kesi*, shauri la mahakamani. Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili vinashiriki jina hilo. Mgombato inatoa majina mawili ya Kiswahili, *kivunjahakumu* ('kivunja hukumu') na *mcheka na mbingu*.

reason.en: Also a 'hoe breaker' used in ending disputes
reason.sw: Nao ni 'kivunja jembe' kinachotumika kumaliza ugomvi

mgombato: chivuma nyuchi (vi) 1) type of plant (Agathisanthemum bojeri); mcheka na mbingu, kivunjahakumu. 2) type of dance; aina ya ngoma.
